desc: Parkour 3-air gap — a 3-air-block void (x=1,2,3) → land 4 cells away (x=4), a dist-4 jump that ONLY clears at real SPRINT speed. A LONG runway (x=-5..0) gives the run-up room to reach sprint; CATCH-FLOOR at y=93 (a miss = ~2-heart fall, not death). greedy_drive to x=8: expect the run-up to retreat→charge→sprint-launch and land on x=4+, NOT fall. The executor must reach cfg.nav.parkourTakeoffSpeed at the take-off edge or it ABORTS to a bridge (never undershoots).
